about: Starter editions: statewide contacts for states without county-level research yet. Every county routes to the state veterans agency plus national aging, ombudsman and Medicare counseling locators. Each veterans phone was matched to the agency's own website on the review date. Run scripts/make_starter_states.py after editing, then scripts/build_public.py.

ombudsman.name: Long-term care ombudsman locator
ombudsman.organization: National Long-Term Care Ombudsman Resource Center

states.name: Alabama
states.local_note: The department has veterans service offices in 62 counties.

states.name: Alaska

states.name: Colorado
states.local_note: Each Colorado county has a veterans service office.

states.name: Connecticut
states.agency: Connecticut Department of Veterans Affairs, Office of Advocacy and Assistance
states.local_note: The office has five district offices. Main department line: 860-616-3600.

states.name: Delaware
states.local_note: Service officers work from the Dover office and serve all three counties.

states.name: District of Columbia
states.local_note: The office acts as the state-level veterans agency for District residents.

states.name: Hawaii
states.local_note: Part of the State of Hawai‘i Department of Defense.

states.name: Idaho
states.local_note: Ask for a service officer near you.

states.name: Iowa

states.name: Kansas
states.local_note: Free Veteran Service Representatives help with VA claims from field offices across Kansas.

states.name: Louisiana

states.name: Maine
states.local_note: Field and itinerant offices serve veterans across Maine.

states.name: Maryland

states.name: Mississippi

states.local_note: Ask for the veterans service office that serves your area.

states.name: Nebraska
